rapport_notes: Warm, friendly tone throughout; good humor (Labor Day comment), responsive to customer needs, builds easy rapport.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not hold silence after the agenda question—immediately moved to logistics probing without letting the customer fully respond to 'What are the most important things I can answer for you outside of pricing.'

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'Now before I kinda hop in. What are the most important things that I can answer for you on the call outside of pricing' — frames as a question but no explicit time-box or promise of an accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep: 'What are the most important things that I can answer for you on the call outside of pricing of course cause that's important.' Customer responds: 'biggest thing is gonna be if like I can push that move back to Saturday' and 'two stops.' Asked before logistics detail-gathering started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep hears 'can I push to Saturday' and 'two stops.' For Saturday: rep says 'Well, neither one of those or any issues at all. So just so you know, we do have availability on this day' — no follow-up, straight to logistics. For two stops: rep says 'Well, let me do this to start here. So what would be the first step, the storage unit?' — one clarifying question, no genuine second layer (e.g., 'tell me more about why two stops matters to you'). No depth on either concern.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Never asked. No mention of damage coverage, what items need careful handling, or the '$2,000 coverage' differentiator anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never asked. No mention of 'Meet Your Mover' (who's showing up, crew lead name, what to expect) anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No 'on-time performance' or 'guarantee' language anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.communication: Never mentioned. No reference to day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates, or communication protocol anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives range: '$510 which would be around that minimum to $714' tied to '2.5 to 3.5 hours' and 'one bedroom apartment.' Personalizes to move size and floor, but does not anchor to 'a typical [size] takes [N] movers [X-Y] hours' framework. Partial credit.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Rep: 'you'll pay for the time you use' and later 'the cost range is $555 to $777' with time range '2.5 to 3.5 hours.' Acknowledges it as a range but does not explicitly name the specific factors (e.g., 'if the crew works faster,' 'if you're more packed'). Counts as a light 'is a window' acknowledgment.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Never mentioned. No reference to 'if they finish early you pay less' or 15-minute increment pricing anywhere.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Never mentioned. No suggestion that customer packing/prep work beforehand reduces the bill anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: Rep never uses 'does that feel fair' language. No silence-holding checkpoint after any open-ended question.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: Never mentioned. No statement that 'your rate locks when you book' or equivalent anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Rep does not make an explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?'). Call ends with 'I'm gonna send over a confirmation email' and logistics confirmation, not a clear close to move toward booking.

top_strength: Rep excellently identified and asked the customer's own agenda before diving into logistics, and responded flexibly to the customer's schedule constraints (Saturday vs. Wednesday preference), showing attentiveness and adaptability.
coaching_note: Stage 2 takeaway was never delivered—the call jumped from discovery straight to estimate and logistics without surfacing and selling the two critical differentiators (On-Time Guarantee and Communication Plan) that the customer never raised; Save Your Ass framework was also only partially present (no 'commit to rate,' no 'beats it pay less,' no self-prep tip), and the close was missing the explicit rate-lock and booking ask entirely.
